in_sanskrit.name: केतु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The shadow of the moon, representing the south lunar node in Hindu astrology.

in_hindi.name: केतु
in_hindi.long_meaning: कड़े: a pot, container or vessel. गड़ी: round, circular, or a hump. स्कन्द: a celestial body. केतु: The shadow of the moon or the south lunar node in Hindu astrology.

in_tamil.name: கெடு
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஆவி: a helper or assistant. கடவுர: a deity. குடவல்: a snake. கெடு: The shadow of the moon or the south lunar node in Hindu astrology.

in_telugu.name: కెటు
in_telugu.long_meaning: పొట్టు: a pot or vessel. గోడీ: a round or circular shape. శోడేశ్: a celestial body. కెటు: The shadow of the moon or the south lunar node in Hindu astrology.

in_marathi.name: Ketu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ketu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ketu is a shadow planet that represents spiritual growth, transformation, and self-realization through trials and tribulations.

in_bengali.name: Ketu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Shadow planet
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ketu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Ketu is a shadow planet that represents spiritual growth, transformation, and self-realization through trials and tribulations.
